messages:
anya: FYI — support spike: several customers reporting 413s on POST /v1/embeddings with mixed-dimension inputs. Console shows 'quota exceeded' which is misleading.
sam: Can you paste a minimal repro (headers + body) so we can trace?
anya: example snippet:
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "embed-300m",
  "inputs": [[...512...], [...768...]],
  "batch_size": 8
}
```
Clients are also sending an `Embedding-Dims` header (e.g. `[512,768]`) so the runtime splits into sub-batches.
miguel: Right — runtime does a dims-aware split => multiple internal requests. Our preflight logic computes an estimated "units" cost based on dims and length, but the console quota check uses bytes-only accounting. That mismatch is why UI blames quota while runtime returns 413/payload-too-large.
sam: Oof. So telemetry and UI are looking at different estimates.
miguel: Proposal (short-term): emit a structured telemetry event `embed.preflight.estimate` that contains `estimated_units`, `split_count`, `correlation_id` and `reason` (oversize|mixed-dims|too-many). Also add a server-generated response header `X-Embed-Estimate: 42` on the initial 413/failure responses so the console/support UI can surface a concrete hint.
anya: Love the telemetry event. Quick note: the header must be server-calculated and response-only (clients can and will fake headers). Server must overwrite any incoming header.
karen: On the console side we should map 413 + estimate -> friendly hint: "Try reducing batch size to N, or send uniform-dimension batches. Click to split automatically." Also show a link to the request trace and the `estimated_units` so support can validate. Feature-flag this UX.
sam: Implementation plan we discussed: 1) runtime emits the preflight event and attaches `correlation_id` to trace; 2) response includes `X-Embed-Estimate` for canary requests; 3) ingestion pipeline stores the estimate in trace/logs for 7d; 4) console reads trace by correlation_id and surfaces the hint behind a flag.
miguel: We should also add runtime metrics: `embed.preflight.estimate_mismatch_rate` (cases where preflight != actual token units) and `embed.split_fallback_rate` (how often we split due to mixed dims). Add a dashboard tile comparing preflight vs actual cost distribution so we can detect drift after any model/kernel change.
anya: Security/QA items: ensure servers overwrite inbound estimate headers, add a test for forged header, test high-cardinality dims (lots of different dim sizes) to avoid high-cardinality telemetry tags.
deply-bot: deploy finished: `feat/embed-estimate-header` canary rolled to staging (eng-staging cluster).
sam: I'll open the PR for console hinting and add the UI copy options (reduce batch / auto-split). I'll also add a small SDK note that we will ignore client-sent estimate headers.
anya: I'll file a short support runbook and add two canned responses: one for "mixed dims" and one for "payload too large — recommend split/batch change". Thanks all. :+1:
